items.title: More device batteries
items.text: Razer headsets and mice, Bluetooth devices that report a battery level, and other brands with a known protocol. Today only Logitech wireless devices show a battery.

items.title: Spotify extras
items.text: Like a song, see and change the queue, pick playlists and switch the playback device. Needs a Spotify login; today the island uses Windows' media controls only.

items.title: Pal shows what your coding agent is doing
items.text: The current step (reading, editing, running a command) and a live view of the code it changes, with a setting to keep code off the screen.

items.title: Both displays, polished
items.text: One focus timer shared by both islands, and an island on every monitor (today: two).

items.title: Launcher
items.text: A calculator and file search in the search box.

items.title: Linux
items.text: Wired and wireless devices with battery, and drag-to-any-edge placement.

items.title: Signed installer
items.text: So Windows SmartScreen no longer warns on first install.
Message your coding agent (text and images) from the Pal tab, and this roadmap in Settings.
Wired and wireless devices (Logitech battery), per-app player volume, shuffle and repeat.
Island on both displays, launcher search and quick links, apps the island stays visible over in fullscreen.
